內容明細.內容: 張偉光博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院院長兼教授。他擁有香港科技大學的金融博士學位，曾在嶺南大學，格里菲斯大學，科廷大學和弗林德斯大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任科廷大學金融與銀行系系主任以及弗林德斯大學商業、政治與法學院商業研究组别主管（相當於副院長（學術方向））。 張偉光博士的研究興趣是與金融相關的實證問題。他長期的研究興趣是了解當代商業問題中的金融/財務機制。目前，他試圖從金融/財務角度了解諸如企業社會責任，無形資本，LGBT，社交媒體，比特幣和貿易信貸等問題。他曾獲得各種研究資助，包括中國國家自然科學基金會，澳中未來對話基金會和AFAANZ研究資助。他還是北京大學和香港科技大學的訪問學者。他的出版物曾在國際上期刊上發表，其中包括：公司金融期刊, 銀行與金融期刊，商業道德期刊，英國會計評論, 澳大利亞管理，會計與金融期刊，當代會計與經濟學期刊，商業研究期刊，經濟模型，能源經濟學，應用經濟學和亞洲經濟學雜誌等。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Wai Kong (Adrian) Cheung is currently the Dean and Professor of Finance, Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD in finance from Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.  He previously taught at Lingnan University, Griffith University, Curtin University, and Flinders University. Before joining City University, he served as Head of Department of Finance and Banking at Curtin University and Research Section Head (equivalent to Associate Dean (Research)) in the College of Business, Governance and Law at Flinders University, respectively. Adrian's research interest is empirical issues in finance. His long-standing research interest is in understanding the finance mechanisms underlying contemporary business issues. Currently he seeks to understand issues like CSR, intangible capital, LGBT, social media, bitcoin, and trade credit from a finance perspective. He has been the recipient of various research grants, including National Natural Science Foundation of China, Australia-China Future Dialogues Fund, and AFAANZ Research Grant. He was also a visiting scholar at Peking University and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. His publications have appeared in international journals: Journal of Corporate Finance, Journal of Banking and Finance, Journal of Business Ethics, British Accounting Review, Financial Review, International Review of Economics and Finance, International Journal of Finance and Economics, Australian Journal of Management, Accounting and Finance, Journal of Contemporary Accounting and Economics, Journal of Business Research, Economic Modelling, Energy Economics, Applied Economics, and the Journal of Asian Economics.

She was teaching in Lingnan University (Hong Kong) and University of Macau and has wide experience teaching in China, France and Portugal. She has conducted various consulting and training programmes in the field of Human Resource and Strategic Management and involved in organizing and managing various research projects over the years. Her research areas of interest are Entrepreneurship Management, Global Comparative management, Human Resource Management in China and Strategic Management in the Asian Pacific Region.

Arman Eshraghi教授擁有二十年的學術研究、教學和領導經驗，曾在英國（卡迪夫大學、愛丁堡大學和曼徹斯特大學）任職，並在美國（哈佛大學）、英國（劍橋大學、倫敦大學學院）以及亞洲（日本、中國、新西蘭）擔任訪問學者。在進入學術界之前，他還在銀行業擁有數年的專業經驗。Eshraghi教授在行為金融學、金融科技以及公司金融/治理等領域享有國際聲譽，其研究成果發表于金融、會計和管理學領域的頂尖同行評審期刊，包括《 Review of Financial Studies》、《 Review of Finance》、《 Accounting, Organizations and Society》以及《哈佛商業評論》。他的研究獲得了廣泛的媒體報道（包括《金融時報》、《福布斯》、《華盛頓郵報》、彭博社、BBC、歐洲新聞台）。他現任《Global Finance Journal》（ABDC 'A'級，影響因子：5.5）的主編，以及《British Accounting Review》和《European Journal of Finance》的副主編。作為一位活躍的國際學者，Eshraghi教授已在全球範圍內受邀舉辦了55場學術研討會，發表了45場主題演講，並共同主持了20場國際學術會議，其中包括歐洲一些最大規模的金融學會議。他曾擔任卡迪夫金融科技研究組的創始聯合主任、行為金融學協會（主辦歐洲規模最大的行為金融學專題會議）的聯合主任，並通過威爾士金融科技機構和英國政府為英國的金融政策討論做出了貢獻。埃什拉吉教授也是一位屢獲殊榮的教育者，在MBA、理學碩士和博士層面均有卓越教學表現。他曾在11個國家教授過多樣化的金融學課程，並在高管教育和公共參與方面擁有豐富經驗，例如，他做過一次關於金融科技的TEDx演講，在YouTube上的觀看次數約25萬次，並為金融播客及其他媒體活動撰稿。
內容明細.內容（英文）:
Arman Eshraghi is a professor of finance with two decades of academic research, teaching and leadership experience across the UK (Cardiff University, University of Edinburgh, University of Manchester) , visiting fellowships in the US, UK, Japan and New Zealand, and some years of professional experience in the banking sector prior to academia. Prof. Eshraghi's research and scholarship is internationally recognized in areas including behavioral finance, financial technology, and corporate finance/governance with publications in leading peer-reviewed journals across finance, accounting and management, including the Review of Financial Studies , Review of Finance , Financial Management, Journal of Empirical Finance, Journal of Business Finance and Accounting, Accounting, Organizations and Society, British Journal of Management, and the Harvard Business Review . His research has received wide media coverage including the Financial Times , Forbes , Washington Post, Bloomberg , BBC and Euronews . He is currently the Editor-in-Chief of the Global Finance Journal (Q1, ABDC A) and Associate Editor of the British Accounting Review (Q1, ABDC A*) and the European Journal of Finance (Q1, ABDC A) .
As an active international scholar, Prof. Eshraghi has delivered around 60 invited seminars worldwide, 55 invited keynotes and co-chaired 20 international academic conferences including some of the largest finance conferences in Europe. He has served as the founding director of Cardiff Fintech Research Group , co-director of Behavioral Finance Association which hosts the world's largest conference series on behavioral finance, and has contributed to UK financial policy discussions through Fintech Scotland , Fintech Wales and the UK Government. Prof. Eshraghi is also an award-winning educator across MBA, MSc, and PhD levels. He has taught a diverse range of finance modules across 11 countries and has extensive experience in executive education and public engagement, eg, a TEDx talk on financial technology with around 250,000 views on YouTube, contributions to finance podcasts and other media engagements.

內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Ting Yang is currently an associate professor of finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He received a Ph.D. degree (in finance) from the Nanyang Technological University. Before joining the City University of Macau, he worked at the Department of Finance of the Auckland University of Technology in New Zealand for more than 18 years. Prior to pursuing an academic career, he worked in industry for about 4 years.

內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Yang has taught finance courses for bachelors, and research and professional masters programs. He won the Excellence in Student Centered Learning Award from Faculty of Business, Auckland University of Technology in 2009.

內容明細.內容: 楊博士目前的研究興趣為公司金融、市場微觀結構和投資學。他的研究成果曾在國際會議上宣講，曾發表在Journal of Banking and Finance, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Accounting and Finance, International Review of Financial Analysis等金融期刊上。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Yang’s current research interests are in the areas of corporate finance, market microstructure, and investments. 內容明細.內容: 我現任澳門城市大學金融學院應用經濟學教授。在加入澳門城市大學之前，我曾在奧地利、中國、德國、英國/馬來西亞和新加坡的多所大學擔任各級經濟學與國際商務教授。2020年至2023年，我入選上海高校「東方學者」計畫，並列入上海市國外高層次人才專案。除了學術任職之外，我還曾在奧地利國家銀行和奧地利經濟研究院工作數年，將學術知識與實踐應用相結合並從事政策諮詢。
內容明細.內容（英文）: I am a Professor of Applied Economics at the School of Finance at the City University of Macau. Before joining City University of Macau, I was a Professor (all ranks) of Economics and International Business at universities in Austria, China, Germany, Great Britain / Malaysia, and Singapore. From 2020 to 2023, I was an Oriental Scholar (“東方學者”計劃) of Shanghai Universities, and I was included in the foreign high-talent program of Shanghai. In addition to my academic appointments, I spent several years outside academia (at the Austrian National Bank and the Austrian Institute of Economic Research) to supplement my academic knowledge with practical application and to engage in policy consulting. My teaching experience at universities spans 25 years. I taught courses on various economics- and international business-related subjects for undergraduate (BSc), postgraduate (MSc, MBA), and PhD students. I have supervised numerous PhD theses, as well as postgraduate and undergraduate dissertations. My current research focuses on international investment agreements and investor-state dispute settlement, examining their impact on the decisions of multinational enterprises and on governments' economic policies. I received funding from highly competitive sources (e.g., the Austrian Science Fund and the Shanghai Talent Program), and I have published numerous articles in reputable international journals. I am a Research Associate at the Austrian Institute of Economic Research, founded by Nobel Memorial Prize laureate F.A. von Hayek and L. von Mises. I am an Associate Fellow of Higher Education (Great Britain), a Subject Editor of Emerging Markets Finance and Trade, and an Editor of Humanities and Social Science Communications, both of which are JCR Q1 journals.

內容明細.內容: 我的大學教學經驗已達25年，面向本科（理學學士）、研究生（理學碩士、工商管理碩士）和博士生教授多個經濟學與國際商務相關課程，並指導了大量博士論文、研究生和本科生畢業論文。
我目前的研究聚焦於國際投資協定及投資者—國家爭端解決機制，以及它們對跨國企業決策和政府經濟政策的影響。我曾獲得多個高競爭力科研專案資助（如奧地利科學基金、上海市人才發展基金），並在多家國際權威期刊上發表多篇學術文章。
我還是奧地利經濟研究院的研究員，該研究院由諾貝爾經濟學獎得主F.A.馮·哈耶克和L.馮·米塞斯創立；是英國高等教育學會的准研究員；並擔任 JCR 一區期刊《新興市場金融與貿易》和《人文與社會科學通訊》的版塊編輯。

李建強博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院教授。他有二十多年豐富的教學及科研經驗, 指導過數十位博士畢業生, 曾任南昌大學特聘教授傑出人才、台灣中山大學管理學院終身教授等。曾擔任美國, 英國, 馬來西亞, 羅馬尼亞及泰國等高校訪問學者。長期從事綠色金融、能源金融、可持續金融等領域。主持國家社會科學基金重點項目、省部級項目等。入選”2024ScholarGPS全球前0.05%頂尖學者(近五年)”、 “全球前2%頂尖科學家”、 “馬奎斯世界名人錄終身成就獎”、“中國高被引學者”、“安子介國際貿易研究獎” 、“高等教育國家級教學成果獎“ 等獎項。在Web of Science上H指數78，累計被引用超過2萬餘次。先後擔任Energy Economics、Energy Journal、Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews、Applied Economics、Economic Analysis and Policy、Innovation and Green Development、Data Science and Management、Emerging Markets Finance and Trade等期刊的主編及客座主編，以綠色金融, 能源轉型, 可持續金融, 人工智能等為主題開設特刊。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Chien-Chiang Lee is currently a Professor of Finance at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. With over 20 years of extensive teaching and research experience, Dr. Lee has supervised numerous PhD graduates. He has held prestigious academic positions, including Distinguished Professor and Talent Scholar at Nanchang University, and Lifetime Professor at the School of Management, Sun Yat-sen University in Taiwan. Dr. Lee has been a visiting scholar at universities in the United States, the United Kingdom, Malaysia, Romania, and Thailand. His research focuses on green finance, energy finance, international finance, and sustainable finance. He has led major projects funded by the National Social Science Fund of China as well as provincial-level initiatives. Dr. Lee has received numerous accolades, including recognition among the “Top 0.05% of Highly Ranked Scholars™”, "Top 2% of Scientists Worldwide," "Lifetime Achievement Award" from Marquis Who’s Who, designation as a "Highly Cited Researcher in China," the "T. K. Ann International Trade Award," and the "National Teaching Achievement Award in Higher Education." With an H-index of 78 and over 20,000 citations on Web of Science, Dr. Lee has served as editor, associate editor, and guest editor for journals such as Energy Economics, Energy Journal, Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, Applied Economics, Economic Analysis and Policy, Innovation and Green Development, Data Science and Management, and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. He has organized special issues on topics including green finance, energy transition, sustainable finance, and artificial intelligence.

內容明細.內容: 李強，現任澳門城市大學金融學院經濟學教授。他的研究長期聚焦於人力資本、家庭結構等勞動經濟學領域，在Health Economics (HE), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), Economic Modelling (EM), China Economic Review (CER),《經濟學（季刊）》，《中國農村經濟》等SSCI與CSSCI權威期刊發表了30餘篇論文，論文被引用超1000次，參與及主持多項國家社會科學基金重點項目、國家自然科學基金面上項目等課題，出版專書和調查報告共5部，獲四川省社會科學優秀成果三等獎。承接博士研究生《數據分析與建模》及本科生《統計學原理》、《定量研究方法高階》等課程。北京大學、中山大學訪問學者，北佛羅裡達大學國家公派訪問學者，擔任中國勞動經濟學會理事，廣州鄉村振興研究會理事；經濟學（季刊），世界經濟、中國農村經濟、公共管理評論，HE, EM, JHS, CER, SSM, EHB等權威期刊匿名審稿人。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Qiang Li is currently a Professor of Economics at the School of Finance, City University of Macau. His research focuses on development economics, particularly in the fields of environment, health, and family structure. He has published over 30 papers in SSCI and CSSCI journals such as Health Economics (HE), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), Economic Modelling (EM), China Economic Review (CER), China Economics Quarterly, and China Rural Economy. His work has been cited more than 800 times. He has led and participated in multiple national-level research projects, including key projects under the National Social Science Fund and the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He has authored five monographs and research reports and received the Third Prize in the 17th Sichuan Provincial Outstanding Achievement in Social Sciences. He teaches courses such as "Data Analysis and Modeling" for doctoral students and "Principles of Statistics", "Advanced Quantitative Research Methods" for undergraduate students. He is a visiting scholar at Peking University and Sun Yat-sen University, and a government-sponsored visiting scholar at the University of North Florida. He serves as a council member of the China Labor Economics Society and Council Member of Guangzhou Research Association for Rural Revitalization. He serves as an anonymous reviewer for authoritative journals including China Economics Quarterly, The World Economy, China Rural Economy, Public Administration Review, Health Economics (HE), Economic Modelling (EM), Journal of Happiness Studies (JHS), China Economic Review (CER), Social Science & Medicine (SSM), and Economy and Human Biology (EHB).

內容明細.內容: 李偉平博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院副教授。他擁有香港城市大學的金融博士學位，並曾在中山大學任教。在加入城市大學之前，他曾擔任中山大學國際金融學院助理教授。李偉平博士的主要研究興趣是公司金融、綠色金融、數位金融和文化金融。目前已在Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability、Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money、Business Strategy and the Environment、Energy Economics、Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(nature旗下刊物)、Pacific-Basin Finance Journal、International Review of Economics and Finance. Finance、會計研究等國際SSCI/SCI與國內CSSCI期刊發表多篇論文。主持廣東省自然科學基金面上項目1項。他也擔任Humanities and Social Sciences Communications(Nature旗下刊物, SSCI Q1)與Scientific Reports(Nature旗下刊物, SCI Q1)期刊編委, China Journal of Accounting Research(ABS2, ESCI Q1)的青年編委，西南財經大學中國政府審計研究中心（CCGAR）的研究員。此外，他也是中國會計學術聯盟青年學者委員會的委員，以及泰山學院商學院的兼任教授。請造訪他的Google學術頁面以了解更多資訊（https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl）
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Li Weiping is currently an associate professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from City University of Hong Kong. Before joining City University, he served as an assistant professor at the International School of Business & Finance at Sun Yat-sen University. Dr. Li's main research interests include corporate finance, green finance, digital finance, and cultural finance. He has published numerous papers in international SSCI/SCI journals such as the Journal of Business Ethics, Journal of Financial Stability, Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money, Business Strategy and the Environment, Energy Economics, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series), Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, International Review of Economics and Finance, and Accounting & Finance. He is the principal investigator of a project funded by the Natural Science Foundation of Guangdong Province. In addition to his academic role, he serves as editorial board member of Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Series, SSCI Q1) and young editorial board member of China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1). He is also a member of the Center for China’s Governmental Auditing Research (CCGAR) at the Southwest University of Finance and Economics. Furthermore, he is an esteemed member of the Young Scholars Committee within the Accounting Academic Alliance in China. He is also the special appointed professor at Business School, Taishan University.
Please visit his Google scholar for more information(https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=-IFsMDgAAAAJ&hl)

內容明細.內容: 我非常致力於指導學生並促進合作研究環境的形成。我熱情地邀請對學術研究充滿熱情並希望在未來追求教職的本科生、研究生和博士生。如果你渴望參與學術工作並尋求你學術旅程的指導，請隨時與我聯繫。我已經指導並與我的學生合作，在一些著名的SSCI期刊上發表了文章，例如Journal of Business Ethics(FT50, ABS3, SSCI Q1), Journal of Financial Stability(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Business Strategy and the Environment(SSCI Q1, ABS3), Energy Economics(SSCI1, 會計研究科學基金Markets Review(SSCI Q1), China Journal of Accounting Research(ESCI Q1)等期刊發表論文。

內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Fei Su is currently an associate professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from UTS Business School and an M.Sc. in Economics from University of Macau. Before joining City University of Macau, he served as a lecturer and an associate professor (tenured) at the College of Economics and Management, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics. Dr. Su's research interests include corporate finance, financial market, and market microstructure. He has published numerous papers in renowned international SSCI/SCI journals such as the International Review of Financial Analysis, International Journal of Finance & Economics, and Pacific-Basin Finance Journal. He has served as the principal investigator (PI) of a project funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC). In addition to his academic role, he serves as an early career editorial board member of Journal of Chinese Economic and Business Studies (ESCI Q1) and an associate editor of Journal of Transition Economics and Finance.

內容明細.內容: 陳學政老師目前擔任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授一職。此前，他曾在江西財經大學經濟學院任副教授，在四川大學經濟學院任特聘副研究員。 陳老師2001年从廈門大學獲得經濟學學士學位，後於2013年從英國華威大學獲得經濟學博士學位。 陳老師的主要研究領域包括政治經濟學、金融經濟學以及行為與實驗經濟學，多篇專業論文發表於國內外一流期刊，如《經濟研究》、《Journal of Comparative Economics》和《International Review of Economics and Finance》等。陳老師曾在多項國家級課題研究項目中擔任主要研究員，科研成果荣获多個獎項，包括国内重要学术会议的優秀論文獎和四川省社會科學優秀成果獎等。 除此之外，陳老師還是《經濟研究》、《Journal of Politics》、《Small Business Economics》、《International Political Science Review》、等著名期刊以及Routledge / Taylor & Francis出版社的評審人。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Chen currently holds the position of Assistant Professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau. Previously, he served as an Associate Professor at the School of Economics, Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics, and an Associate Research Fellow at the School of Economics, Sichuan University. Dr. Chen graduated from Xiamen University with a Bachelor Degree in Economics in 2001 and obtained a PhD Degree in Economics from the University of Warwick in 2013. Dr. Chen's primary research areas include Political Economy, Financial Economics, and Behavioral and Experimental Economics. He has published several research papers in distinguished domestic and international journals, such as Economic Research Journal（《经济研究》）, Journal of Comparative Economics, and International Review of Economics and Finance. Dr. Chen has served as the principal investigator in multiple national-level research projects. His research achievements have been recognized with various awards, including Outstanding Paper Awards at two top-tier academic conferences and an provincial-level Outstanding Achievement Award. In addition, Dr. Chen has served as an anonymous peer reviewer for several renowned journals, including Economic Research Journal, Journal of Politics, Small Business Economics, International Political Science Review, and for the Routledge / Taylor & Francis publishing house.

內容明細.內容: 華君怡博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。她擁有美國俄亥俄州大學的經濟學博士學位。作為一名應用計量經濟學者，她運用微觀數據來理解微觀個體的經濟行為。她熱衷於研究經濟區域內農業、環境問題（如氣候變化、水資源與空氣污染）、土地供給、政策和城市化的相互關係，以及基於這些關係的可持續經濟發展的政策建議。在她所參與的美國 USDA 科研項目 Thriving Agricultural Systems in Urbanized Landscapes 中，她與生態、水文、環境科學等其他專業學者進行跨學科合作研究，通過提出有效可行的政策建議來解決政府管理成本導致的負外部性、資訊不對稱以及適應環境變化所導致的隱藏成本。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Junyi Hua is currently an Assistant Professor of Economics at Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. She received her PhD in Agricultural, Environmental, and Development Economics from The Ohio State University. As an applied econometrician, her research uses micro-level data to understand human behavior at a micro-level. Her research focus is on the agricultural implications and housing supply changes resulting from the effects of climate change on land markets and agricultural outcomes. Her interest in exploring issues of sustainable economic growth from the perspective of land use management in the short and long run leads to productive collaboration with researchers in ecology, hydrology, and environmental earth sciences seeking viable and effective policy solutions to cope with the negative externalities including the implicit cost of government regulation and the implicit costs of adaption to environmental challenges. Understanding of how farmers and landowners respond to changes in climate factors, as well as the impact of these changes on the urbanizing landscape is a unifying theme in her research program. Her research consists of three core components. The first component is the understand the drivers of agricultural decision making and resulting land prices. The second is to embed agricultural behavior into models of urbanization. Lastly, she combines these ideas to examine climate change scenarios impacts on urbanization patterns and agricultural behavior.

內容明細.內容: 李蒙博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他於西班牙馬德里卡洛斯三世大學獲經濟學博士學位，曾在西南財經大學財政稅務學院任教。其研究領域包括宏觀經濟學、財政政策、一般均衡理論、經濟周期、收入和財富不平等以及國際稅收等；科研論文曾發表在《宏觀經濟動態》《經濟模型》等國際期刊，並擔任《宏觀經濟動態》《亞太經濟》《應用經濟學》《新興市場金融與貿易》等學術期刊的匿名審稿人；還與另兩位學者合作出版了專作《數字中國：財稅政策優化與制度構建》。李蒙博士曾獲得教育部人文社會科學研究一般項目青年項目和澳門教育基金的資助。在加入澳門城市大學之前，他主持過西南財經大學校级教学改革项目。他曾榮獲稅務專業碩士教學指導委員會第三屆全國稅務案例大賽二等獎和西南財經大學第四屆“課程思政”教學競賽暨優秀教案評選一等獎，指導學生獲得第三屆全國本科稅收風險管控案例分析大賽二等獎、第三屆四川省大學生財稅實務技能大賽二等獎、第二屆成渝雙城經濟圈高校稅務案例大賽一等獎以及西南財經大學“優秀碩士學位論文光華獎”。所授《國際稅收》課程曾榮獲四川省省級線上一流本科課程稱號。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Meng Li is currently an Assistant Professor in Faculty of Finance at City University of Macau. He received his PhD degree from University of Carlos III in Madrid and worked in Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. His major research interests are macroeconomics, fiscal policy, business cycle, general equilibrium, income and wealth inequality, and international taxation. His research papers have been published in international journals, including Macroeconomic Dynamics and Economic Modelling. He works as an anonymous reviewer of some international journals, such as Macroeconomic Dynamics, Journal of the Asia Pacific Economy, Applied Economics, and Emerging Markets Finance and Trade. He also coauthors with other two scholars to publish a book “Digital China: Fiscal Policy Optimization and System Construction.” Dr. Li has obtained the grants from the Youth Project of Humanities and Social Science Fund of Ministry of Education and Macao Education Fund. Before joining City University of Macau, he hosted a project of the teaching reform in Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. He obtained the second-class award of the third national contest in cases of taxation by the committee of teaching guidance in master of taxation and the first-class award of contest in “merging ideology and politics into courses” by Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. He also advised students to obtain the second-class award of the national contest in regulations on tax risks, the second-class award of the Sichuan provincial contest in practical skills in public finance and taxation, the first-class award of the Chengdu-Chongqing contest in cases of taxation, and the award of the excellent master dissertation by Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. His course of International Taxation was awarded as the first-class undergraduate online course in Sichuan.

內容明細.內容: 劉偲現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。本人2018年畢業於英國雷丁大學ICMA中心，取得金融學博士學位。曾任西南財經大學金融學院副教授、碩導。主要從事公司金融、公司治理、機構投資者以及銀行監管等方面的研究。個人代表作‘The IRB model, bank regulatory arbitrage, and the Eurozone crisis’曾在美國金融學會年會博士生專場(AFA 2018 Philadelphia)展示，並以獨立作者身份發表在金融領域國際知名高水平期刊Journal of International Money and Finance。同時，本人另有7篇一作/通訊作者論文發表在國際高水準期刊（SSCI 1區)，期中 International Review of Financial Analysis 1篇，Finance Research Letters 5篇，Pacific Basin Finance Journal 1篇）。此外，本人曾作為主研參與省部級項目2項。本人在任教西南財經大學期間,曾擔任主講人之一的線上課程《投資學》，已於2020年上線中國大學慕課平台MOCC。該課程於2022年獲得四川省省級一流（線上）本科課程。

許文立博士，武漢大學經濟學博士，現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授，安徽生態與經濟發展研究中心特聘研究員。主要聚焦中國宏觀經濟政策、環境氣候政策、DSGE、計算經濟學和DID等相關領域。主要研究成果發表在《經濟研究》（兩篇）《經濟學（季刊）》《世界經濟》《數量經濟技術經濟研究》《財貿經濟》《財政研究》《Journal of Regulatory Economics》《Economic Analysis and Policy》《Environmental Science and Pollution Research》等中英文權威期刊，公開發表文章60多篇。出版了個人專著《推動綠色發展》，並主持了教育部人文社科、財政部、安徽省教育廳重點研究項目4項。研究成果先後榮獲鄧子基財稅優秀論文獎以及安徽省社會科學優秀成果二等獎等。
內容明細.內容（英文）: Dr. Xu Wenli, Ph.D. in Economics from Wuhan University, Assistant Professor at the Faculty of Finance, City University of Macau, and Special Researcher at the Anhui Research Center for Ecology and Economic Development. He mainly focuses on China's macroeconomic policies, environmental and climate policies, DSGE, computational economics and DID and other related fields. His main research results have been published in Economic Research (two articles), Economics (Quarterly), World Economy, Quantitative and Technical Economic Research, Finance and Trade Economics, Fiscal Research, Journal of Regulatory Economics, Economic Analysis and Policy, Environmental Economic Analysis and Policy", "Environmental Science and Pollution Research" and other authoritative journals in English and Chinese, published more than 60 articles. He has published his personal monograph "Promoting Green Development", and presided over 4 key research projects of the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance and Anhui Provincial Department of Education. His research results have been honored with the Deng Ziji Excellent Paper Award in Finance and Taxation and the Second Prize for Excellent Achievements in Social Sciences in Anhui Province.

內容明細.內容: 王方志博士現任澳門城市大學金融學院助理教授。他於北京理工大學獲經濟學博士學位，曾赴英國薩塞克斯大學訪學一年。其研究方向為環境與數字宏觀經濟學，特別致力於氣候經濟複雜系統建模與應用相關研究。科研論文發表在European Economic Review, Decision Analysis (INFORMS), Economics Letters, Energy Economics, Structural Change and Economic Dynamics、《系統工程理論與實踐》等國內外期刊，研究工作被全球氣候變化綜合評估模型聯盟官網正面報導，榮獲全英/全歐中國經濟學會第二屆氣候領導力國際會議“最佳論文獎”，且在世界資源與環境經濟學家大會、CEPR研討會、歐洲環境與資源經濟學年會等多個國際重要會議做展示。他目前獲國家自然科學基金青年科學基金項目（C類）資助，並曾參與國家自然科學基金重大項目、傑出青年基金項目的研究工作。
